patch.value: Pinned SDK 2026.11.2 runtime-public-contracts.d.ts exports PmClientOptions with pmRoot, cwd, author and noExtensions only. Backend handle injection and native authoritative provider capabilities are not exported. Open upstream dependencies verified: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1587 and https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1588. The authorized directory-read slice does not claim native database support.
Bind authorized projects to native SDK backend handles
Remaining provider and read-surface slice of roadmap #260; consume the shared upstream authoritative backend contract.

Use an upstream backend-bound SDK handle rather than a compatibility tracker; map authorized project, principal, effective permission and backend scope to immutable identity without exposing tenant or connection details; move remaining paginated list, settings and history reads through supported capabilities; preserve all directory and no-git behavior; prove filesystem and native database CRUD/search/custom metadata with no local tracker and explicit unsupported-feature responses; reuse pm-graph ProjectionSource for observational native graph reads without an item mirror.
